historical_event: Hundimiento del RMS Titanic - 1912: El transatlántico RMS Titanic se hunde tras chocar con un iceberg en el Atlántico Norte, muriendo entre 1,490 y 1,635 personas.

techmeme.headline: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.4-Cyber, a fine-tuned GPT-5.4 variant for defensive cybersecurity use cases, to some participants of its Trusted Access for Cyber program
techmeme.context: OpenAI is letting a select group of users access a new artificial intelligence model that's meant to be more adept at cybersecurity tasks.

techmeme.headline: Memo: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel says the company plans to lay off ~1,000 full-time employees, or 16% of its global workforce, to cut costs and achieve profitability
techmeme.context: Snap Inc. is laying off roughly 1,000 full-time employees, or 16% of its global workforce, as part of an effort to cut costs.

techmeme.headline: Google releases a Windows desktop app with a macOS Spotlight-like search box for the web, Google Drive, and local files, a screen sharing feature, and more
techmeme.context: After testing got underway in September, the 'Google app for desktop' is now launching for Windows users globally in English.

science.headline: Graphene just defied a fundamental law of physics
science.summary: In a major breakthrough, scientists have observed electrons in graphene flowing like a nearly frictionless liquid, defying a core law of physics. This exotic quantum state not only reveals new fundamental behavior but could also unlock powerful future technologies.

bigthink.headline: If life exists on Mars, it's likely hiding — or maybe sleeping
bigthink.relevance: Relevante porque la búsqueda de vida en Marte es un objetivo clave de la exploración espacial y podría cambiar nuestra comprensión de la vida en el universo.
